title: Youthful Yellow Thai Chicken Curry
description: A savory and juicy Thai dish featuring tobiko, perfect for a sick day, made with satvik-friendly ingredients. This curry is a delicious and comforting meal that will help you feel better in no time.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the tobiko, fish sauce, brown sugar, salt, and pepper.
Let the curry simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the curry hot over rice or noodles.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
